articles.summary: How Chili's went from invisible to #2 in casual dining. CEO Kevin Hochman's four-year turnaround—cutting the menu 25%, anchoring a $10.99 value deal, and picking a fight with fast food—drove +113% profitability and beat Olive Garden. But rising tickets and beef costs are now testing whether the myth becomes a dynasty.
articles.title: Chili's Mythical Run Teardown
